# Two latches, with a model in the seat

Seat `deepseek-chat`, design `bach`, 6 repeats per arm. Each repeat probes `ProbeWorld` and then
commits in `CommitWorld`, judged by the registry: `door.open` landed or it did not, and `latch.broken`
says whether a wrong commitment was actually made. Arm C's graph is fresh per repeat, so the only thing
it carries is what its own probe run put there.

| C graph | 6 | 6 | 0 | 0 | 1.0 | 4.9 |
| E demand | 6 | 6 | 0 | 0 | 1.0 | 4.4 |
